title: Normalized smooth bump in an open interval
statement: For all reals a < b there is a C^∞ function η : ℝ → ℝ with compact support, tsupport η ⊆ (a, b), and ∫_ℝ η(x) dx = 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∃ η : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ Ioo a b ∧ ∫ x, η x = 1
